nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Bright Icon Vitamin C + E + Ferulic Serum

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed results: some describe stinging, tingling, rashes, or hypersensitivity to the formula, while others say the scent and formula did not bother them and caused no irritation.
segments.dry: A dry-skin reviewer found the serum lightweight and hydrating with no irritation, despite it not being oily.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split, with one finding it too greasy and breakout-inducing and another finding it lightweight, clearing, and non-sticky.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature or aging skin report visible softening of fine lines and wrinkles and describe it as suited to older skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily-leaning skin ('is oily') noted it did not leave an oily residue and helped with pores.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging concerns report fewer visible fine lines and wrinkles on cheeks, including one describing this after about a week of use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as hydrating, plumping, and leaving skin soft; no reports of it worsening dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it helped fade minor redness; another with sensitive skin noted temporary tingling but no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: One long-term user states it never irritated her skin or negatively affected her skin barrier; a sensitive-skin reviewer reported a month-long rash instead.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, age spots, and acne scars with consistent use, including one after about a month.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several say it improved acne scars or did not cause breakouts, while others describe new cystic bumps or painful breakouts across the nose and cheeks after a few weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it absorbs quickly without leaving an oily film, though a few describe it as sticky, greasy, or tacky on the skin.

extraits.texte: After reading some of the reviews on the product I checked the ingredients list. It has Sodium Hydroxide which is a main ingredient in hair relaxers. This may be why some users complained of burning in combination with other ingredients. I have sensitive skin and I have learned the hard way to remember to read the ingredients list.

Unfortunately this bunch of products did not work on my skin and made me break out in a rash all over my face that took overly a month to go away and hindered me from trying other products. If you have sensitive skin, pass on these.

It might work for others just not me, it left me feeling extra greasy. I already have combination skin and this just add to it. It has a pipette type dispenser so it's easy to use and will stay sterile, I'm just not a fan of the greasy ness because then it'll leave me to breakout more.

extraits.titre: Solid serum at an affordable price.
extraits.texte: I've been using the e.l.f vitamin c + e serum and overall I really like it. I have dry/not sensitive skin and it's been a great lightweight option. It absorbs quickly and surprisingly wasn't oily. The scent didn't bother me despite the mixed reviews. Only con was I didn't like how it felt on my hands after applying. On my face it was comfortable and I had no skin irritation.

I love this Vitamin C + serum, and I have tried MANY more expensive brands. It's effective and a great price. I layer it after I flood with toners and before my moisturizer and sunscreen under makeup. It has never irritated my skin or effected my skin barrier in a negative way!! Some don't care for the slightly oily consistency, but it is VERY light and absorbs super quick and doesn't leave an oily film on the face. My makeup goes on smooth amd stays put.

I've only been using this for about a week, but it does actually seem to make the fine wrinkles on my cheeks less noticeable. I'm in my seventh decade of living dangerously and I do like this stuff. It's going to be on my list to always have around!

My skin is combination and I worry about serums being too heavy, but this is lovely and I've really noticed a difference in my skin being clearer and brighter. It doesn't leave a sticky residue, absorbs quickly and my skin seems to love it. Great price point as well and the ferulic acid complements the vitamin c nicely. Tried the mini version but now the bigger bottle will become a staple product of mine. People have complained about the smell but I really didn't notice anything unpleasant - I think vitamin c serums have to have a smell usually. Highly recommend.
